abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop. Overall, Brostamide reduces side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.

section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.
